Question.TranslatedText: Please complete the information below in order to learn more about the FOCUS program. By completing the information below, you are agreeing to be contacted about the FOCUS application. If you are completing this information on behalf of someone else, please ensure they have provided permission to share their information and be contacted about FOCUS.
Are you filling this for yourself or someone else?
What is the guardian's full name?
What is the guardian's phone number?
Interested in being a research participant (complete a series of online questionnaires)?
Thank you! A member of the study team will be in touch shortly to share more information.
Interested in learning about study (description call)?
Reason for no interest in description call?
Is client over the age of 18?
Can the client speak English fluently?
Is client receiving mental health services at [health_center]?
Does the client plan to continue services at this place for the next three months?
Does client have difficulty seeing or hearing the phone when using it? Are they unable to read the screen and work the buttons on a touch screen phone? (Eligible = No, but assess how difficult)
